title: The Ultimate Broken JSON Fixer & Smart Formatter
target_pain: Developers, data analysts, and LLM users constantly deal with malformed, truncated, or messy JSON containing single quotes, trailing commas, unquoted keys, smart quotes, or missing closing brackets. Manually fixing these syntax errors is tedious and time-consuming.
key_features: Auto-repair unquoted keys and single-quoted keys/values
Fix curly/smart quotes and strip JS-style comments
Auto-balance and close missing brackets/braces from truncated LLM outputs
Remove trailing commas before closing braces/brackets
One-click Copy, Download, Minify, and Beautify options
Instant validation status with detailed error reporting
